patients.summary: Administrative assistant who joins in 2020 with obesity and recurrent UTIs on nitrofurantoin prophylaxis. PCOS, hidradenitis and IBS are diagnosed by outside specialists in 2022; gallstones lead to cholangitis, ERCP with sphincterotomy for sphincter of Oddi dysfunction and cholecystectomy in 2024. Pregnant in 2025, she develops nitrofurantoin liver injury after her last practice visit and delivers at term in May 2026.

conditions.label: Personal history of urinary tract infections
conditions.note: three or more episodes a year before prophylaxis

medications.sig: Take 1 capsule by mouth at bedtime

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
New patient. 26 y/o woman moving her care here; prior PCP office closing its adult panel. Records requested.

Concerns today: none acute. Wants a regular doctor and help with weight.

PMH: recurrent bladder infections since about age 23, at least three a year, cultures at the old office per pt. Prior PCP put her on nightly nitrofurantoin and she has had none since starting it. Acne as a teen and in her early 20s, used prescription creams, nothing now. Weight has been her biggest frustration.
PSH: none.
Meds: nitrofurantoin 100 mg at bedtime.
Allergies: none to medications.
FH: mother with type 2 diabetes and gallstones; father with high blood pressure; one sister with polycystic ovaries.
SH: administrative assistant. Smokes cigarettes daily, has tried to stop before. No alcohol. Lives locally.

ROS: negative except as above. No dysuria now.

Exam: well appearing, NAD. Vitals as recorded; BMI 36. HEENT normal. Neck supple, thyroid not enlarged. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear bilaterally. Abd soft, nontender, no organomegaly. Skin without rash. Ext warm, no edema. Mood and affect appropriate. PHQ-9: 3.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 36. Talked about realistic targets, food log, walking at lunch. Recheck weight in a year or sooner.
2. Tobacco use. Advised to quit; she is not ready to set a date but open to revisiting. Offered support whenever she wants it.
3. Hx recurrent UTI on prophylaxis. Doing well on nitrofurantoin, will continue and refill here.
4. Health maintenance: Tdap today (no record of one since high school). Baseline CMP, CBC, lipids, A1c, TSH. One-time HIV and hep C screening, she agrees. Pap 2019 at prior office, normal per pt; will confirm with records. Flu shot when this season's supply comes in.

RTC 1 year for physical, sooner prn.

documents.title: Immunization Record
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Tdap 0.5 mL IM given L deltoid. VIS provided. Tolerated without issue, observed 15 min.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Denise, all of your blood work from Monday came back fine: blood count, kidney and liver tests, cholesterol, sugar (A1c) and thyroid were normal, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to change. Good to meet you.

documents.title: Prior primary care records
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Records from prior primary care office received by fax, 22 pages, scanned to media. Includes office notes 2016-2020, urine cultures 2017-2018, and cervical cytology 08/2019 (negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy). Nitrofurantoin prophylaxis started there in 2018 after repeated cystitis. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Records review
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Reviewed outside records. Several E. coli cystitis cultures 2017-18, all pan-sensitive, then on nitrofurantoin since. Pap 2019 normal, next due 2022. Nothing else to add to her history.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Influenza Vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here after work for her flu shot. Screening questions negative, no egg or vaccine reactions. Quadrivalent influenza 0.5 mL IM R deltoid. Left without problems.

documents.title: Refill request
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy fax: nitrofurantoin 100 mg caps, #90, last fill 10/2020. Last seen 9/2020. Pended for PCP.

documents.title: Immunization registry update
documents.author: MA
documents.body: State registry shows two Pfizer COVID-19 doses at a retail pharmacy, 3/26/21 and 4/16/21. Entered into her immunization history.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Came in to tell me she stopped smoking a week ago, cold turkey. She has started trying to get pregnant and that was the push. Some irritability, sleeping fine, no cravings she can't handle. Wants to know what she should be taking. Still on nightly nitrofurantoin, no bladder infections.

O: Vitals as charted, weight down a little since September. Well appearing. Heart and lungs normal.

A/P:
- Former smoker as of last week. Congratulated her. Offered nicotine replacement; she prefers to do it without. Quitline number given.
- Preconception: start a prenatal vitamin daily (folic acid). Nitrofurantoin is fine to continue while trying. Let me know when she has a positive test so we can get OB involved early.
- Recheck at physical in the fall.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam, 27F.

Interval: still not smoking since April, proud of it. Trying to conceive for about five months, no luck yet, not worried yet. Lost about 5 kg since last fall with walking and cutting soda. No UTIs on prophylaxis. Taking prenatal vitamin.

Meds: nitrofurantoin 100 mg qhs, prenatal vitamin daily. NKDA.

ROS: no fevers, weight change intentional, no bowel or urinary complaints, mood good.

Exam: vitals as charted. Alert, comfortable. Eyes and ears normal. Neck without thyroid enlargement or nodes. CV regular rate, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin warm and dry. No peripheral edema. Neuro grossly intact. PHQ-9 = 2.

Assessment/plan:
1. Well adult exam. Flu vaccine today. Labs: CMP, lipids, A1c.
2. Obesity, improving. Keep at it.
3. Former smoker, 5 months.
4. UTI prophylaxis, continue.
5. Pap due next year.
COVID booster when she becomes eligible.

documents.title: Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs look good: sugar, cholesterol, kidney and liver numbers all normal. Keep doing what you're doing.

documents.title: Pharmacy immunization notice
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy notification: Pfizer COVID-19 booster given 12/4/21. Added to immunization history.
